fields.help_en:
The departure and arrival city codes, separated by Chinese commas "，".
Pass 0 to disable city restrictions. Note: When cities are unrestricted, ensure hotel travel standards are passed for all cities.
When the allowed booking category is 0/6/21/25, three-letter airport codes or six-digit city codes are accepted.
When the allowed booking category is any other value, only six-digit city codes are accepted.
city_set and city_code_set must have a one-to-one correspondence.
Note: When the itinerary includes a flight-type itinerary, if the specified city has no airport, flight itineraries cannot be booked.

Three-letter airport code data (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-flight-city-data.xlsx)
Administrative division city code data (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)

cityset和citycode_set必须一对一

parameters.help_en:
The domestic hotel budget.

Currency unit: CNY, in cents.
<warning>Miscellaneous charges incurred by specially authorized guests during their stay (meals, in-room items, etc.) are deducted at checkout and paid by the enterprise.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
国内酒店预算

货币单位：人民币，分。
<warning>特殊授权人住店产生的杂费（用餐、房间内商品等）将在退房时扣款，由企业支付。></warning>
parameters.name: hotel_budget

parameters.help_en:
The domestic flight budget.

Currency unit: CNY, in cents
parameters.help_zh:
国内机票预算

货币单位：人民币，分
parameters.name: flight_budget

parameters.help_en:
The train ticket budget.

Currency unit: CNY, in cents.
<warning>For the same seat class such as "hard sleeper", upper/middle/lower berths have price differences. During booking, the budget balance is validated against the highest price.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
火车票预算

货币单位：人民币，分。
<warning>例如坐席同为”硬卧“，上/中/下铺存在价格差异的情况，预订时将按照其中最高价格，校验预算余额。></warning>
parameters.name: train_budget

parameters.help_en:
The car service budget.

Currency unit: CNY, in cents.
<warning>Uncontrollable factors in ride-hailing scenarios may cause the actual price to exceed the estimated price: 1. The passenger changes the destination offline. 2. Traffic congestion or other road incidents. 3. The driver adds surcharges such as tolls, highway fees, or waiting fees.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
用车预算

货币单位：人民币，分。
<warning>打车场景存在不可控因素，会超出原预估价格：1. 乘客线下修改目的地；
堵车等道路意外情况；
司机添加附加费，如过路费、高速费、等待费等。></warning>
parameters.name: vehicle_budget

Specifies whether to merge budgets of multiple business trip approval forms.

Multiple approval forms with the same union_no can have their budgets merged and used interchangeably

是否合并多个出差审批单预算

【union_no】相同的多个审批单，预算合并求和，可以混用

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restrict travelers.

0: Do not restrict travelers. 1: Restrict to travelers on the approval form.

<warning>If the approval form does not restrict travelers and no default travel standard (default_standard) is passed, the traveler information on the approval form is not stored, and actual travelers are not subject to travel standard restrictions.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
是否限制出行人

0：不限制出行人，1：限申请单内的出行人。

<warning>若审批单“不限制出行人”，没传申请单默认差标（default_standard)，则审批单传入的出行人信息不会存储，实际出行人也不限制差标。></warning>

fields.help_en:
The premium economy class discount.
Pass an integer from 1 to 10.
1 means 10% of the full price. 10 means no discount

超级经济舱折扣。
请传入 1 到 10 的整数。
传 1 时为 1 折；传 10 时为不打折
